note: V7.3 plan. skip_ranks = V7 slate ke kaunse rank nahi khelne (1 = MAIN). Stake = Rs per jodi. haruf type bahar = aakhri ank, andar = pehla ank. 'overrides' = tay tarikhon ke liye alag plan (tool aur bot dono aaj ki tarikh dekh kar chunte hain); baaki dino ke liye 'markets'. copy_amounts=false: copy/Telegram message mein sirf numbers (rupaye nahi). count = kitne rank khelne (default 8; Desawar 10 = rank 9-10 bhi). calendar = din/mahine/cool-down ke stake multipliers. date_rule = aaj ki tarikh wala number (aur uska palti) plan ke numbers se hata do. cold_rule = thanda number (jo 'days' din se kisi market mein nahi aaya) plan ke numbers se hata do. haruf_rule = haruf ka ank kis niyam se (prev2 = us market ke do draw pehle wala ank).

overrides.label: NOVEMBER HIGH-STAKE PLAN (1-30 Nov)
overrides.rules: Backup Rs3 lakh alag. Mahine ka ghaata Rs1.5 lakh par stake Rs400; Rs2 lakh par normal plan. 1 Dec se apne aap normal plan. Desawar base Rs500 x Nov 1.5 = Rs750 (thanda din Rs375, garam din cap par Rs750). Gali Rs750 base: Sun/Fri Rs1,125, Tue/Wed Rs375, thanda Rs375, garam Rs1,125. Desawar 10 number 1 Dec se.

calendar.note: Stake multipliers (sirf jodi par; haruf flat). mult = weekday x month x cool-down, phir cap. Cool-down trigger = Desawar ka result us din ki V7 top-8 list mein tha (hamara hit): us raat Gali aur agli subah Desawar same_day_mult; agar us raat Gali (plan numbers) bhi hit -> agli subah Desawar SKIP. rebound_after_days game-day baad Gali/Desawar rebound_mult. Walk-forward 2015-2026: Gali +35.5% -> +42.7% ROI, Desawar +32% -> +38%.

cooldown.trigger: Desawar result in that day's V7 top-8

date_rule.note: Operator aaj ki tarikh wala number (jaise 22 tarikh ko 22) aur uska palti kam kholta hai: sab 6 market mein 0.50% / 0.66% (tukka 1%), 2013-2026. Plan ke numbers mein aisa number ho to hata do; uski jagah naya number nahi. Desawar ke liye tarikh = jis subah result aata hai. 'from' se pehle ke dino par lagu nahi (purana hisaab waisa hi rahe).

cold_rule.note: Thanda number: plan ka jo number pichhle 'days' din mein (aur aaj ab tak) chhe mein se kisi bhi market mein nahi aaya, use hata do; uski jagah naya number nahi. 'Due' wali soch ka ulta. Walk-forward 2015-2026 (Gali rank 2-8, tarikh niyam ke upar): aise number 1.06% aaye (80/7,542; tukka 1%, barabar 1.11%), baaki list-number 1.61%. ROI 2015-22 +36.7% -> +51.8%, 2023-26 +21.9% -> +31.0% (12/12 saal behtar); roz ~7 ki jagah ~5 number, hit wale din 9.3% -> 7.7%. Desawar par fayda nahi, isliye sirf Gali. 'from' se pehle ke dino par lagu nahi.

haruf_rule.note: prev2 = haruf ka ank us market ke do draw pehle ('parson wale') result se, jab pichhle draw ka wahi ank us se alag ho. Desawar andar 2015-2026: 12.7% (487/3,835; barabar 11.1%), dono daur mein same (12.7% / 12.6%); V7 ka ank 11.8%; jab dono alag hon to parson wala 12.2%, V7 wala 10.8%. Kal wala andar dobara sirf 8.7% aata hai. Jab kal aur parson ka ank ek hi ho to V7 ka ank; agar V7 ka ank bhi wahi ho to us din haruf nahi. Result adhura ho to V7 ka ank. 'from' se pehle ke dino par lagu nahi.
